out.title: Missing Machine Training
items: Nobody showed the new hire how to use the packing machine.
The new hire learned the machine only by watching others.
Machine training was skipped in the first week.
No one explained how to operate the line equipment.

out.title: Language Barriers in Training
items: Training documents are only in Malay and hard to read.
The new hire cannot understand the English-only SOP.

out.title: System Access Delays
items: The new hire still has no login for the stock system.
System access took two weeks to arrive.
The new hire waited days for a staff card and password.

out.title: Missing Safety Resources
items: Safety slides were not available in Chinese.

out.title: Canteen Food Issues
items: The canteen food is too salty.

out.title: Late Night Overtime
items: Overtime happens every day until late at night.
The new hire works past 10 pm most days.
Shifts often run three hours longer than planned.

out.title: Weekend Work Expectations
items: Weekend work is expected every week.
The new hire must come in on Saturdays and Sundays.
Rest days are often cancelled for weekend orders.

out.title: Idle Work Periods
items: There is very little work and long idle periods.
The new hire waits for hours with nothing to do.
Tasks run out before lunch most days.

out.title: Lunch exclusion
items: Colleagues eat lunch together but never invite the new hire.
The new hire always sits alone in the canteen.
Nobody asks the new hire to join for lunch.

out.title: Language barrier in chats
items: The team chats in a language the new hire does not speak.
Meetings switch to Cantonese and the new hire is left out.
Jokes in the group chat are in a dialect the new hire cannot follow.

out.title: Missing from chat group
items: The new hire was not added to the team group chat.
Shift updates go to a chat the new hire is not in.
The new hire hears about team news last because they are not in the chat group.
